newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Bomb blast kills two, wounds 19 in Karachi.
newsitem.headline: Bomb blast kills two, wounds 19 in Karachi.

text.p: At least two people were killed and 19 were wounded on Saturday in a bomb explosion in a house in Pakistan's southern city of Karachi, police said.
Police said the bodies of two men, one of whom had been decapitated in the blast, had been recovered from the debris of the collapsed house near Liaquat Market in District East.
People in nearby houses were injured by the explosion, but none critically, police said. An ambulance worker said earlier that a child and three women were among the wounded.
Police said the explosion had been caused by a home-made bomb, but gave no details. It was not immediately clear if the bomb had been detonated deliberately or by accident.
There was no claim of responsibility for the blast.
Ethnic, sectarian and political violence in Karachi has claimed about 50 lives this year, compared to more than 500 in the whole of 1996 and about 2,000 in 1995.
